title: Synchrony Horizon: dependency orchestration playbook for cross-team roadmaps
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Problem: As Redwood scales Dedicated and Private offerings, cross-team dependencies (Eng, Design, Security, Infra) are causing late handoffs and undetected blockers during cycle cutovers. We need a lightweight orchestration playbook that ties roadmap milestones, readiness gates, and a minimal automation surface so PMs can predict risk and unblock earlier.

Scope: Draft and pilot a dependency orchestration playbook (Synchrony Horizon) covering intake, triage, risk scoring, automated pings, and cutover handoffs. Pilot with two initiatives: runtime-1.18 kernel-scheduling change and console-2025.04 rollout of the dependency dashboard. Exclude full tool-building for Q2; focus on process, templates, and 2 automation hooks (Slack reminders + readiness dashboard flags).

Goals:
- Reduce last-week blocker rate for pilot initiatives by 60%.
- Surface high-confidence dependency readiness signal for 90% of tracked dependencies at T-3 weeks.
- Decrease manual escalation pages by 40% via automated routing and template-based handoffs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Playbook published in Confluence with roles, templates, and triage cadence.
- Slack automation configured to send weekly dependency digest to initiative leads and owners.
- Readiness dashboard shows green/amber/red per dependency and historical on-time completion.
- Two pilot initiatives complete with retro notes and quantitative delta on blocker incidence.

Measurement: tracker in Amplitude/Looker for dependency-state transitions, weekly blocker count, number of escalations, and time-to-resolution. Baseline collection starts 2025-02-10.

Trade-offs and constraints:
- Avoid large engineering investment in a dependency engine this quarter; prefer orchestration via existing tools (Linear + Slack + Console flags).
- Playbook must be lightweight and adoptable by PMs without centralized enforcement.

Rollout plan: draft -> PM + Eng sync -> design templates -> automation proto -> pilot with two initiatives -> retro + iterate -> scale. Target pilot end 2025-03-28.

2025-03-03: Pilot kickoff meeting with initiative leads; assigned owners for each dependency and set T-3 readiness check cadence. Jonah to run first digest on 2025-03-07.

risks: Adoption risk: teams may not update dependency states without incentives; mitigation: PM weekly enforcement + exec visibility for pilots.
Tooling gap: Console flags may not capture all handoff signals; mitigation: keep Slack digest and require link to ticket/PR.
SLA friction: Dedicated customers expect stricter gating; mitigation: surface requirements early and add 'customer escalation' lane for high-impact deps.
